subject: A migration reached production from an unmerged worktree; and which PR owns the CI collision at merge time

(b) when p4-i and this campaign branch both reach main, CI check E2 fails on whichever merges SECOND, which is not the PR that owns the bug — who resolves it, and on which PR?
evidence: git: commit 54f7cbef6 is NOT an ancestor of HEAD; file present only under .clone/worktrees/* on pariprashna/p4-i (PR #1497)

(3) Coordinate with the p4-i owner so the disclosure lands on the PR that owns the bug rather than the one that merges second.
recommendation: Option 1 for the campaign, Option 2 as a separate governance note the native may want independent of Nirmana.
